capabilities: Sync vault files between devices through the user's own OneDrive account
Sync Obsidian settings, themes, hotkeys and community plugins selectively
Resolve conflicts using content hashes and per-file baselines
Recover deleted files and previous versions from a sync recycle bin
Migrate vaults from Remotely Save, iCloud or the OneDrive client
extras: Free and MIT-licensed. Does not provide end-to-end encryption: cloud copies are plain files in the user's OneDrive. Strongly warns against running it alongside other sync tools (Obsidian Sync, Remotely Save, iCloud/OneDrive client folders) on the same vault, and requires identical vault names on all devices. Documentation is in Chinese; support via GitHub Issues and a Xiaohongshu account. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid service, and users who want device sync through their own cloud storage without third-party relay servers have to rely on generic sync clients or other plugins.

relations.evidence: EasySync 直接连接 Microsoft 登录和 Microsoft Graph，不使用第三方中转服务器
登录 OneDrive 后，EasySync 会检测 OneDrive 应用目录里有没有 Remotely Save 建立的同名仓库

summary: Vault sync plugin that keeps notes and settings in sync across devices through the user's own OneDrive account, with two-way and one-way modes.
